export A=parent; env -i A=child sh -c 'echo $A'; echo $A
dd if=/dev/zero of=/mnt/Audit/help/zeros bs=1024 count=8; cksum /mnt/Audit/help/zeros
printf keep > keep; dd if=/dev/zero of=keep bs=2147483648; cat keep
dd if=/mnt/Audit/help/binary of=seek ibs=7 obs=13 seek=2 count=5; cksum seek
printf prefix > gap; dd if=/mnt/Audit/help/binary of=gap bs=31 count=1 seek=10 conv=notrunc; cksum gap
dd if=/dev/zero of=empty count=0; cksum empty
p=$(mktemp /mnt/Audit/help/owned.XXXXXX); test -f "$p"; echo created:$?; rm "$p"; test -f "$p"; echo removed:$?
TMPDIR=/mnt/Audit/help; export TMPDIR; p=$(mktemp); echo "$p"; rm "$p"
env -i A=one /mnt/Audit/tools/awk 'BEGIN { print ENVIRON["A"]; print ENVIRON["HOME"] }'
printf safe > oomkeep; dd if=/dev/zero of=oomkeep bs=1048576; echo failed:$?; cat oomkeep
printf locked > locked; hfsattr --locked on locked; dd if=/dev/zero of=locked bs=16 count=1; echo failed:$?; hfsattr --locked off locked; cat locked
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/null bs=1024 count=16; status runtime

export BIG=''; env -i BIG="$BIG" /mnt/Audit/tools/printenv BIG | wc -c; unset BIG
